calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) AS n_cur FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1),
lastv AS (SELECT member_id, max(valid_from) AS last_from, count(*) AS n_versions, count(DISTINCT valid_from) AS d_from FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1),
tot AS (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) AS all_members FROM dim_member)
SELECT
 (SELECT all_members FROM tot) AS all_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS members_with_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE n_cur>1) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM lastv WHERE n_versions<>d_from) AS dup_valid_from,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to<>DATE '9999-12-31') AS cur_bad_to,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31') AS noncur_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member m JOIN lastv l USING(member_id) WHERE m.is_current AND m.valid_from<>l.last_from) AS cur_not_latest,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) AS odd_tier,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_from > DATE '2026-10-04') AS future_from

calls.statement:
-- version valid on the as-of date (last loaded day 2026-10-04) vs is_current
SELECT 'asof_valid' AS method, tier, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(*) AS rows_
FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-04' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'is_current', tier, count(DISTINCT member_id), count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1,2

calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS gold_current, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS gold_members,
 sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-04' OR join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from < join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS from_before_join,
 min(member_id), max(member_id), sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_home,
 max(valid_from) AS latest_change
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'
